title: Counterexamples to Wegner's Conjecture for Rectangles
summary: Wegner conjectured in 1965 that every finite family $\mathcal R$ of axis-parallel rectangles satisfies $τ(\mathcal R)\le 2ν(\mathcal R)-1$, where $τ(\mathcal R)$ is the minimum number of piercing points and $ν(\mathcal R)$ is the maximum size of a pairwise-disjoint subfamily. We disprove the conjecture by an explicit triangle-free family of $64$ rectangles with $ν=16$ and $τ\ge 32$.
